# Gloria Jean's Dubai Mall

> Gloria Jean's Coffees at The Dubai Mall is an outlet of the international coffee-house chain, which franchises cafes in dozens of countries. It serves espresso-based drinks, iced blended coffees and pastries to shoppers in Downtown Dubai. The Dubai Mall is one of the world's largest shopping centres and a principal retail and leisure destination beside Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Fountain.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This project delivered a new Gloria Jean's Coffees café at The Dubai Mall in Downtown Dubai, adding an outlet of the international coffee-house chain to the mall's food and beverage offer. MENASCO carried out the MEP fit-out works for the café, providing the building services required for a food and beverage unit operating within a major retail destination.
